query.esql:
FROM logs-*
| where azure.open_ai.is_request_success == false and azure.open_ai.properties.backend_response_body.error.code == "content_filter"
| EVAL timestamp=DATE_TRUNC(3 hour, @timestamp) | stats results = count(*) by timestamp | rename timestamp as `@timestamp every 3 hour`
